cv.name: Mikel Mendizabal Arregi
cv.headline: Senior Program Manager | Offshore Wind | Supply Chain background
cv.summary: Industrial engineer with twelve years in the wind energy supply chain in the Basque Country, the last six leading programmes for offshore wind components. My background in supplier development and supply chain management means I can work either as a programme manager or as a supply chain lead.

experience.title: Senior Program Manager
bullets: Lead a €260M programme delivering monopile transition pieces for two North Sea wind farms
Coordinate engineering, procurement, quality and logistics across five suppliers in Spain and Portugal
Introduced a stage-gate review and integrated master schedule in Primavera P6
Recovered a six-week delay on the second project through re-sequencing and supplier support
Report monthly to the client and the steering committee

experience.title: Supply Chain Manager
bullets: Managed sourcing and supplier capacity for nacelle castings and bearings
Set up S&OP meetings and reduced inventory by 18% without affecting deliveries

experience.title: Supplier Development Engineer
bullets: Supplier audits, PPAP and capacity planning for forged components
